page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core and no hyperthreading. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance features a 35 MB L3 cache, lacks local storage, and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.sn2.xlarge sits primarily in the lower tiers for compute-intensive tasks. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively, reflecting its older processor generation. However, it maintains average performance in Passmark CPU tests and large-block memory write operations. For lightweight language model tasks, it achieves average speeds of 446.56 tokens per second for prompt processing on a 135M model, though larger models like the 7B variant drop to a poor 4.89 tokens per second.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is the dedicated CPU allocation versus its lower overall processing efficiency. While the dedicated cores prevent resource contention, the raw compute and memory bandwidth are weak compared to newer hardware generations. Consequently, this server is best suited for general-purpose workloads with predictable resource demands, such as moderate web serving, basic database operations, and lightweight application hosting, rather than high-throughput data processing or intensive compilation tasks.
